notes.title: Improved help.
notes.notes:
Improved help.
- Help will now detect a group of items with a minimum number of remaining items.
- Fixed positioning of the help if the item was near the cat.
- Fixed camera limitation for wide monitors.
- Slightly corrected positioning of some items.

Thanks to everyone who helps to make the game better)
